result.summary: Found 3 issues: overlapping/garbled text under the ramen bar listing, a cut-off restaurant card at the right edge, and inconsistent heart icon styling.

issues.description: The delivery info text under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows overlapping/garbled text reading '25-3€0 mdienlivery · Ramen', indicating two text strings rendering on top of each other
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout so delivery time and delivery fee text do not overlap; ensure proper spacing/line separation

issues.description: The third card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the edge of the screen, with its name truncated
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll padding or card width so the last visible card is either fully shown or clearly indicates scrollability

issues.description: Heart icon on the ramen bar image is white/outline while similar heart icon on the pizza image below has a dark filled circle background, creating inconsistent visual style
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite/heart icon button style (background color, opacity) across all promotional cards
